errors.text: The proposed intervention is adding titanium, but titanium is already an equimolar constituent of the stated CoCrFeNiTi starting alloy.
The hypothesis omits the essential high-energy ball-milling and spark-plasma-sintering intervention.
Ambient-temperature and ambient-pressure conditions are incompatible with the required milling and 900–1000 °C SPS consolidation process.
The prediction that favorable plasticity is retained conflicts with the target result of intergranular fracture and limited ductility.
